_notes: Public safety-net system, Oakland (Alameda County). 5 hospitals (Highland, Alameda, Fairmont, San Leandro, John George Psychiatric). 92% Medi-Cal/government payer mix. Net position negative $70.5M as of Dec 2024. County of Alameda functions as revolving line of credit ($120.9M facility). NO PUBLIC AGENCY RATINGS in window — funded primarily through county appropriations not public muni debt. Severe ongoing distress; Feb 2026 county sought $10M to stave off layoffs.

moodys.citation_text: No active public Moody's rating for Alameda Health System obligor. Alameda County (separate obligor) is rated, but the Health System itself does not appear to have public agency ratings.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Net position negative $70.5M Dec 2024; net negative balance $94.2M (liquidity facility $120.9M offset by restricted cash $26.7M). Operating under increasing reliance on county revolving line of credit.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Alameda Health System's net position is negative $70.5M as of December 2024, with a net negative balance payable of $94.2M consisting of a liquidity facility (loan) of $120.9M offset by restricted cash of $26.7M.

outcome_class_rationale: AHS operates with county-backstopped liquidity rather than public bond debt. No public agency ratings means no rating-action outcome; framework would treat as UNVERIFIABLE for outcome class but the FINANCIAL_DISTRESS disclosure is a Mode-B signal. Edge case for honesty-alpha test: public reporting transparent; not lying.
